link.heading: Link

asks.footer: Ask them for their code. Let them in only if it matches the one here; refuse if it does not or you do not know the name.
asks.emptyDetail: Keep this page open; requests show here when someone opens the link

close.title: Close this link
close.body: Nobody else can join with it. Those who joined stay.
